. The Pauli exclusion principle states

electron was later discovered and Dirac was awarded the Nobel Prize in physics for
his relativistic formulation of the electron. The anti-proton was later discovered.
All particles in nature have associated anti particles, many of which are routinely
produced in particle accelerators.
